jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager - Maât
jobs.description: Our Mission ⚖️ At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform. Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard. Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform. Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that. Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities. Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting. And we're just getting started. Context AI is transforming the legal industry, and the coming years will therefore be decisive in shaping the tools that will define access to the law. Our ambition is to build the European leader in legal AI. We design our products with a global vision because that is our ambition, and we adapt to local needs because law is, by nature, very local. The Doctrine tech and product team (~100 people) is one of the best positioned in the world to drive this transformation. As a Senior Product Manager, you will be involved in every stage of the product development process, from shaping upcoming product innovations to working closely with designers and engineers to bring new features to life. You’ll use your entrepreneurial mindset and full range of skills to deliver simple, elegant features. Are you ready to invent the future of law? Missions Deeply understand the ways of working, needs, and pain points of legal professionals to identify high-impact opportunities. jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description: About Us_ // At Masabi , we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel. Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit. Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what. The Role_ // At Masabi, we're building technology that makes public transport simpler, fairer and more accessible for millions of people. Behind every agency that runs on our platform is a commercial agreement someone had to shape, negotiate and close. As our Legal Counsel, you'll work closely with our General Counsel, leading on our largest and most complex commercial deals. Much of the work follows one opportunity from beginning to end. It starts with major tenders and public procurements, where you'll shape our position on the terms we can work with and the ones worth challenging. From there you'll take the deal through negotiation to signature, with colleagues across the business bringing the commercial and technical detail. Underneath runs the advisory side: data protection and privacy, IP and licensing, and the questions that come with operating across several markets. jobs.description: REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands. We turn hundreds of pages of complex regulations, like MDR and FDA guidance, into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers' development and quality processes. We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A. About the job We're growing from one engineering group into dedicated teams, and we're looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead one of them: the team behind our core customer workflows, such as requirements formulation, document comparison, compliance checks and the AI agents that support regulatory and quality experts. This is a player-coach role. You'll lead a team of around six engineers, including product and ML engineers, and you'll stay close enough to the code to make good technical calls, review designs and step in when it matters. You won't be managing from the sidelines. You'll work closely with the team's product owner and designer, and report to the Head of Engineering. We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week. Make delivery predictable. Work with product on priorities, own how the work is sequenced, and keep commitments to customers realistic and kept. Hold the gaps. jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
